notes: Cases for Vineflower's bundled plugins (VariableRenaming, IdeaNotNull), replayed from the plugins' own tests (plugins/*/src/test) plus one plain-defaults case. Every set turns the bundled plugins on with the kuna option jvm_plugins; the oracle ran the release jar with its bundled plugins (vf-decompile --plugins). Sets with "fixture": true start from the test fixture's base map. Class files are vendored here by plugin_oracle.py; regen.py adds these cases to cases.tsv.

sets.name: Plugin Defaults
sets.source: java -jar vineflower-1.12.0.jar (CLI defaults, bundled plugins loaded); expected text is the oracle corpus's expected-defaults
